story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
1. **AC1:** MCP tool defined: "analytical_query_financial_documents" triggering agentic workflow - Tool registered in FastMCP server with `@mcp.tool()` decorator - Tool accepts `AnalyticalQueryRequest` (query: str, top_k: int = 5) - Tool returns `AnalyticalQueryResponse` with answer, reasoning_steps, sources, workflow_metadata - Tool integrated into `raglite/main.py` alongside existing `query_financial_documents()` from Epic 1/2
2. **AC2:** Tool accepts natural language analytical queries - Input validation: query string max 1000 characters - Query types supported: YoY growth, variance analysis, trend analysis, comparative queries - Pydantic model `AnalyticalQueryRequest` with field validation - Examples validated: "Calculate YoY revenue growth", "Compare Q3 vs Q4 revenue", "Explain variance in operating expenses"
3. **AC3:** Tool routes simple queries to basic retrieval, complex queries to agentic workflow - Uses `classify_query_complexity()` from Story 3.5 planner module - Simple queries (SIMPLE complexity) → call `query_financial_documents()` (Epic 1/2 tool) - Analytical/comparative queries → orchestrate full workflow via `WorkflowExecutor` from Story 3.5 - Routing decision logged with structured metadata
4. **AC4:** Responses include reasoning steps taken (transparency) - Response model includes `reasoning_steps: List[str]` field - Each workflow step documented: "1. Retrieved documents", "2. Analyzed data", "3. Synthesized answer" - Workflow metadata includes: task_count, execution_time_ms, workflow_pattern used - User can see which agents were invoked and in what order
5. **AC5:** Test queries validated: trend analysis, variance explanation, correlation discovery - Test set: 10+ analytical queries from ground truth (complex queries subset) - Coverage: YoY growth (3 queries), variance analysis (3 queries), trend analysis (2 queries), comparative (2 queries) - Success criteria: ≥80% of test queries return valid answers with proper citations - Integration test validates each query type end-to-end
6. **AC6:** User testing via Claude Desktop confirms usability - Manual testing via Claude Desktop MCP client - Test scenarios: Simple query, analytical query, complex multi-step query - User validates: Answer quality, citation accuracy, response time <15s p95 - Feedback documented in story completion notes

doc.title: Epic 3: AI Intelligence & Orchestration PRD
doc.snippet: MCP tool defined: "analyze_financial_question" triggering agentic workflow. Tool accepts natural language analytical queries. Tool routes simple queries to basic retrieval, complex queries to agentic workflow. Responses include reasoning steps taken (transparency).

doc.title: Epic 3 Orchestration Architecture Design
doc.snippet: New MCP Tool: analytical_query_financial_documents(query, orchestration=True). Workflow: 1. Classify query complexity 2. IF simple → simple_search_path 3. IF analytical/comparative → complex_orchestration_path. Latency targets: Simple path 4.7s p50, Analytical path 12s p50.

doc.title: Epic 3 Agent Workflow Patterns
doc.snippet: Conditional Routing Pattern routes queries to different agent workflows based on query characteristics. Simple Queries (70% of traffic): Route to Epic 2 simple search (4.7s). Complex Queries (30%): Route to Epic 3 orchestration (12s). Average latency improvement: 70% × 4.7s + 30% × 12s = 6.9s (42% improvement over always using Epic 3).

doc.title: Epic 3 Agent Workflow Patterns
doc.snippet: classify_query_complexity() classifier returns SIMPLE, ANALYTICAL, or COMPARATIVE. simple_search_path() for fast Epic 2 retrieval. complex_orchestration_path() for full Epic 3 multi-agent reasoning. Routing orchestrator delegates based on classification results.

doc.title: Repository Structure (Monolithic)
doc.snippet: raglite/main.py (~200 lines) - MCP server entrypoint. raglite/agentic/ - Epic 3 orchestration module (planner, orchestrator, fallback, agents). raglite/shared/models.py - Pydantic data models. Total target: 600-800 lines across 15 files.

doc.title: Technology Stack (Definitive)
doc.snippet: MCP Python SDK (mcp) 1.20.0 - Official SDK by Anthropic. FastMCP 2.0 - Production MCP framework extending official SDK. AWS Strands - CONDITIONAL (Phase 3): IF Phase 2 <85% accuracy. LangGraph - CONDITIONAL (Phase 3): IF Phase 2 <85% accuracy.

artifact.reason: Reference pattern for MCP tool definition with @mcp.tool() decorator. Shows how to implement tool with QueryRequest/QueryResponse models, structured logging, and error handling. Story 3.6 will add analytical_query_financial_documents() following same pattern.
Query complexity classifier (AC3). Returns QueryComplexity.SIMPLE or QueryComplexity.ANALYTICAL. Story 3.6 uses this for routing decision: SIMPLE → Epic 2 path, ANALYTICAL → Epic 3 orchestration.
Query decomposition engine (AC3). Generates WorkflowPlan with tasks for retrieval, analysis, synthesis agents. Used by WorkflowExecutor in Epic 3 orchestration path.
Workflow orchestration engine (AC3, AC4). execute_workflow() method coordinates retrieval, analysis, synthesis agents. Returns execution results with task metadata for reasoning steps (AC4).
Graceful degradation handler (AC3). Implements 4-tier fallback: Full orchestration → Partial analysis → Retrieval only → Epic 2 fallback. Used when Epic 3 workflow fails.

Existing request model from Story 3.5 (AC1, AC2). Defines query: str and top_k: int fields. Story 3.6 may extend this or use as-is. Note: Needs reasoning_steps and sources fields added to AnalyticalQueryResponse (AC4, AC6).

Existing response model from Story 3.5 (AC1, AC4). Has answer, complexity, workflow_metadata, confidence, limitations fields. Story 3.6 MUST ADD: reasoning_steps: List[str] field (AC4) and sources field for citations (AC6).

Citation generation engine (AC6). Generates source attributions with page numbers and document references. Used in synthesis agent and Epic 2 simple search. Story 3.6 needs citations in AnalyticalQueryResponse.sources field.

story-context.constraints: - **SIMPLICITY FIRST:** No abstractions, no frameworks beyond approved tech stack. Direct SDK usage only. - **Tech Stack LOCKED:** Only use libraries from docs/architecture/5-technology-stack-definitive.md. NO additions without user approval. - **Model Extension Required:** AnalyticalQueryResponse model MUST be extended with reasoning_steps: List[str] and sources fields (AC4, AC6). - **Routing Overhead Acceptable:** Classification adds ~500ms overhead, but saves 3-5s+ on simple queries (70% of traffic). - **MCP Tool Pattern:** Follow existing query_financial_documents() pattern in raglite/main.py for consistency. - **Structured Logging:** All routing decisions logged with extra={} metadata for observability. - **Performance Targets:** Simple path <5s p50, Analytical path <15s p95 (AC6). - **Error Handling:** Workflow failures handled by handle_workflow_failure() from Story 3.5 - no new error handling needed. - **No New Files:** Story 3.6 ONLY modifies existing files (main.py, models.py) + adds tests. Total: ~575 new lines.

interface.name: analytical_query_financial_documents (MCP Tool)
interface.description: New MCP tool for Story 3.6 (AC1). Accepts AnalyticalQueryRequest, classifies query complexity, routes to Epic 2 (simple) or Epic 3 (analytical) path, returns AnalyticalQueryResponse with answer, reasoning_steps, sources, workflow_metadata.

interface.name: classify_query_complexity (Planner Module)
interface.description: Story 3.5 classifier (AC3). Returns QueryComplexity.SIMPLE or QueryComplexity.ANALYTICAL. Used by Story 3.6 routing logic to determine Epic 2 vs Epic 3 path.

interface.name: WorkflowExecutor.execute_workflow (Orchestrator Module)
interface.description: Story 3.5 orchestrator (AC3, AC4). Executes multi-agent workflow (retrieval → analysis → synthesis). Returns WorkflowResult with task execution metadata for reasoning steps (AC4).

interface.name: query_financial_documents (Existing MCP Tool)
interface.description: Existing Epic 1/2 tool (AC3). Simple retrieval path for SIMPLE queries. Story 3.6 routes 70% of traffic here (4.7s latency). No modifications needed - reuse as-is.

interface.name: AnalyticalQueryRequest (Pydantic Model)
interface.description: Existing model from Story 3.5 (AC1, AC2). Input validation: query max 1000 chars, top_k range 1-50. Story 3.6 may need to add max_length=1000 constraint (AC2).

interface.name: AnalyticalQueryResponse (Pydantic Model - NEEDS EXTENSION)

interface.description: Existing model from Story 3.5. Story 3.6 MUST ADD: reasoning_steps: List[str] field (AC4) for transparency, and sources field (AC6) for citation display. These are CRITICAL for AC4 and AC6 validation.
